newsitem.title: UK: Matthew Clark extends loss after BZW "sell".
newsitem.headline: Matthew Clark extends loss after BZW "sell".

text.p: Shares in cider maker Matthew Clark Plc fell for a second day on Thursday as analysts at BZW issued a "sell" rating on the stock, dealers said.

Clark shares were down 17-1/2p at 296-1/2 by 1521 GMT, wiping out Tuesday's gains after the company laid out a response to the growth of "alcopops" based on a souped-up marketing drive for its Diamond White, K and other cider brands.
Market sources said BZW analysts warned that there were major risks in Clark's strategy, partly because increased advertising was being funded by price rises and a reduction in trade promotions.
The brokerage warned that the recovery plan as set out could lead to further declines in cider sales, and warned that it expected profits to decline at lease until fiscal 1999, market sources said.
Analysts at BZW were not immediately availble to comment.
